articles.title: Circle and Tether step in to freeze hacker wallet after massive Bitget crypto heist
articles.snippet: The stablecoin issuer blacklisted a wallet holding about $318,000 in USDT and USDC. Most of the stolen funds sit in ether, which can't be frozen.

articles.title: U.S. Federal Reserve moves on proposals to implement GENIUS Act for stablecoins
articles.snippet: The Fed proposed rules on putting last year's GENIUS Act into place with regulations, including those governing stablecoin yield programs.

articles.title: European stablecoin issuer Qivalis sees transformation of global trade finance
articles.snippet: Jan-Oliver Sell, the CEO and founder of Qivalis, said the entire trade finance supply chain is moving into stablecoins.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street and crypto fight for the same turf
articles.snippet: Stablecoins and tokenized assets are pushing banks, exchanges and crypto companies into the same markets, from payments to stocks and ETFs.

articles.title: Fed proposes new capital, redemption rules for stablecoin issuers
articles.snippet: The Fed’s proposal would set capital requirements, a two-day redemption window and new reserve disclosures as regulators implement the GENIUS Act.
